description: Check whether the site's ownership is proven: probes the WordPress plugin connection and/or looks for the domain-verification DNS TXT record / meta tag, or (method gsc / bing) asks Google Search Console / Bing Webmaster Tools, or (method cloudflare) asks Cloudflare whether the site's domain is an active zone in the account connected to it. Returns the updated setup state. Docs: https://www.relvato.com/docs/verify-site-ownership

method.description: Domain verification only: check just this method (default: DNS and meta tag). gsc / bing ask Google Search Console / Bing Webmaster Tools whether the account connected to the site (in the dashboard) owns it — Search Console owners only, not full or restricted users. cloudflare asks the Cloudflare account connected to the site (in the dashboard) for an active zone covering it

name: verify_site
title: Verify site setup
